context_files_read.purpose: Controlling repository safety and phase-loop instructions.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; reports are only views over versioned artifacts.
Missing metrics must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and never invented.
P14 is not automatic and must not run without explicit opt-in.

context_files_read.purpose: Repository entry contract and automatic phase boundary.
key_findings: Automatic work stops at P13; P14 requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN and explicit opt-in.
Report layer may read artifacts but must not become source of truth.

context_files_read.purpose: Loop-engineering harness policy for stage design.
key_findings: L05 should strengthen report/visualization golden tests while preserving schema, artifact, and provenance validation.
Stage completion must include precheck, safety scan, compileall, stage-specific pytest, and CI tests.
Anti-regression checks must detect weakened schemas, skipped-without-reason behavior, and historical artifact edits.

context_files_read.purpose: L05 stage requirements and required outputs.
key_findings: L05 must convert audit results, metric catalog, coverage matrix, scale ladder, and P13 timing into readable reports and visualizations.
Required outputs are index.html, coverage_matrix.csv, coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, p13_timing_waterfall.svg, missing_metrics.csv, and provenance_graph.json.
All visualizations must be generated from JSON, JSONL, or CSV artifacts, not hardcoded values.

context_files_read.purpose: Stage handoff and known inputs for L05.
key_findings: L05 inputs already exist: audit_report.json, provenance_graph.json, metric_catalog.json, coverage_matrix.json, p13_p14_scale_audit.json, and P13 scale/timing artifacts.
Existing report tests cover P09 only and do not cover loop-engineering report artifacts.
L05 must not run P14 or real/fault wrapper scripts.

context_files_read.purpose: Baseline status from the prior harness pass.
key_findings: Previous baseline commands passed with 182 tests.
Committed artifact audit, provenance graph, metric coverage matrix, and P13/P14 audit generation all passed schema validation.
L05 begins from a passing source-artifact baseline.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing report renderer test coverage.
key_findings: Current tests exercise valkey_scale_lab.report.render_report for P09 analysis_summary only.
Existing tests assert P09 index.html, CSVs, markdown, SVG chart, and missing metric handling.
No tests cover loop-engineering reports under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing report rendering implementation.
key_findings: Renderer accepts one analysis_summary JSON and writes P09 report artifacts.
Renderer does not consume L01-L04 loop-engineering artifacts or P13 timing/scale audit artifacts.
Renderer has simple SVG and CSV helpers that can inform deterministic L05 output style but should not be stretched to hide missing inputs.

context_files_read.purpose: Current provenance graph builder behavior.
key_findings: Tracks JSON/JSONL source artifacts, hashes, schemas, report views, and P14 dry-run boundary.
Report views are explicitly not source-of-truth.
Current target phases are P09, P11, P12, and P13; L05 should add coverage for loop-engineering report views or a companion manifest without weakening existing DAG checks.

context_files_read.purpose: Current metric catalog and coverage matrix source model.
key_findings: Defines six layers and ten surfaces used by coverage_matrix.json.
Rejects measured metrics sourced from rendered report views.
Records missing, skipped, and no-baseline semantics with explicit reasons.

context_files_read.purpose: Schema for this subagent output.
key_findings: Top-level fields and verdict enum are fixed.
Harness proposal types must use unit, integration, cli, schema, artifact, real_valkey, or ci.

context_files_read.purpose: Coverage matrix contract used by L05 CSV and heatmap outputs.
key_findings: Coverage matrix has exactly the fake, small-real, 30, 50, 100, and 1000-dry-run layers.
Each entry contains status, evidence class, source artifacts, real coverage flag, dry-run flag, and reason.
The 1000-dry-run layer must not count as real Valkey coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: Metric catalog contract used by missing_metrics.csv and report summaries.
key_findings: Every metric records source artifact, sha256, pointer, evidence layer, real coverage flag, dry-run flag, value status, and missing semantics.
MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE_YET require explicit reasons.
Measured metrics must remain tied to source artifacts, not rendered report views.

context_files_read.purpose: Provenance contract for source-to-view traceability.
key_findings: Graph nodes include source_of_truth and artifact_role, allowing L05 tests to prove views are non-source artifacts.
Graph edges carry relation, source and target hashes, and hash status.
P14 boundary is represented as skipped-with-reason and no real Valkey coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: P13/P14 audit source contract for scale ladder and timing views.
key_findings: P13 rungs must include 50 and 100 canonical real Valkey evidence and timing paths.
P14 boundary must remain dry-run-only, opt-in-required, and real_valkey_coverage false.
Timing checks expose missing semantics for optional diagnostic data.

context_files_read.purpose: P13 timing artifact contract for waterfall visualization.
key_findings: Timing summaries include setup, cluster create, replica config, probe, cleanup, artifact write, state load, total, and unattributed accounting fields.
Waterfall tests should verify all required timing components are read from JSON and represented deterministically.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing coverage matrix builder tests.
key_findings: Builder tests already validate layers, surfaces, real Valkey coverage for small/30/50/100, and P14 dry-run boundary.
L05 tests should not duplicate builder internals; they should validate rendered CSV/SVG views over the builder outputs.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing metric catalog tests.
key_findings: Tests already assert source fields, missing semantics, and rendered views not used as measured sources.
L05 missing_metrics.csv tests should verify these semantics survive rendering without blank reasons.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing provenance graph tests.
key_findings: Tests cover source hash mismatch, missing source artifacts, report views used as sources, invalid source schemas, missing metadata, and cycles.
L05 should add provenance-link tests for new loop report outputs and source links in index.html/SVG/CSV artifacts.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing CI gate for metric coverage outputs.
key_findings: CI invokes build_metric_coverage_matrix.py and validates metric_catalog.json and coverage_matrix.json schemas.
CI explicitly forbids P14 opt-in and real/fault wrappers for static coverage gates.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing CI gate for provenance graph outputs.
key_findings: CI invokes build_provenance_graph.py and validates provenance_graph.json schema.
CI forbids P14 opt-in and real/fault wrappers.

findings.description: The current report renderer is scoped to P09 analysis_summary and cannot produce the required L05 loop-engineering report bundle.
evidence: src/valkey_scale_lab/report/render.py accepts a single analysis_path and writes P09-specific report artifacts.
tests/report/test_report_rendering.py only asserts P09 report outputs.
L05 requires artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/index.html, coverage_matrix.csv, coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, p13_timing_waterfall.svg, missing_metrics.csv, and provenance_graph.json.

findings.description: L05 needs golden tests for rendered views because existing tests validate source JSON builders but not CSV, SVG, or HTML view determinism.
evidence: tests/coverage/test_coverage_matrix.py validates coverage_matrix.json content, not coverage_matrix.csv or coverage_heatmap.svg.
tests/metrics/test_metric_catalog.py validates metric_catalog.json content, not missing_metrics.csv rendering.
tests/provenance/test_provenance_graph.py validates source DAG behavior, not links embedded in new L05 report views.

findings.description: Provenance must be extended to cover the new L05 report views without making rendered HTML, CSV, or SVG source-of-truth artifacts.
evidence: schemas/artifact/provenance_graph.schema.json supports report view nodes with source_of_truth=false.
scripts/build_provenance_graph.py currently focuses target phases P09, P11, P12, and P13.
L05 acceptance requires provenance_graph.json among the report outputs.

findings.description: Missing metric rendering needs negative tests so MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE_YET rows keep reasons through CSV, HTML, and SVG summaries.
evidence: AGENTS.md forbids inventing missing metric values.
artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/metric_catalog.json currently contains missing_count, skipped_count, and no_baseline_count.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_report_rendering.py::test_renderer_emits_l05_required_outputs_from_json_artifacts
proposed_harness.acceptance: Runs the L05 report renderer against fixture or committed JSON inputs and asserts index.html, coverage_matrix.csv, coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, p13_timing_waterfall.svg, missing_metrics.csv, and provenance_graph.json are produced under the requested output directory.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_report_rendering.py::test_renderer_refuses_report_views_as_numeric_sources
proposed_harness.acceptance: A fixture that points a measured metric to .html/.csv/.svg raises a deterministic error or emits a blocking finding; report views may be linked but never become measured metric sources.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_report_golden.py::test_coverage_matrix_csv_golden
proposed_harness.acceptance: coverage_matrix.csv has a stable header and exactly one deterministic row per coverage_matrix.json entry sorted by layer order then surface order; rows include status, evidence_class, metric_count, real_valkey_coverage, dry_run_only, reason, and source_artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_report_golden.py::test_coverage_heatmap_svg_golden
proposed_harness.acceptance: coverage_heatmap.svg contains a deterministic 6-by-10 grid with data-layer, data-surface, data-status, and data-evidence-class attributes, a legend for COVERED, MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and dry-run, and no hardcoded metric counts outside coverage_matrix.json.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_report_golden.py::test_scale_ladder_svg_golden
proposed_harness.acceptance: scale_ladder.svg derives rung labels, node counts, PASS/SKIPPED status, and real/dry-run styling from scale_ladder_report.json and p13_p14_scale_audit.json; P14 appears only as dry-run or skipped-with-reason and never as real coverage.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_report_golden.py::test_p13_timing_waterfall_svg_golden
proposed_harness.acceptance: p13_timing_waterfall.svg reads p13_timing_breakdown_scale_50.json and p13_timing_breakdown_scale_100.json, renders setup, cluster_create, replica_config, probe, cleanup, artifact/state/accounting/unattributed components, and labels optional missing diagnostics as MISSING with the audit reason.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_missing_metrics.py::test_missing_metrics_csv_preserves_all_missing_semantics
proposed_harness.acceptance: missing_metrics.csv includes every metric_catalog metric whose missing_semantics.status is MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET; reason is non-empty for every row and value columns remain blank rather than fabricated.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_missing_metrics.py::test_missing_metrics_visual_markers_are_source_driven
proposed_harness.acceptance: When a fixture changes a coverage cell or metric from measured to MISSING, both coverage_heatmap.svg and index.html reflect the changed status from JSON input without source code changes.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_provenance_links.py::test_index_links_every_view_to_source_artifacts
proposed_harness.acceptance: index.html contains links or data-source-path attributes for audit_report.json, metric_catalog.json, coverage_matrix.json, p13_p14_scale_audit.json, P13 scale ladder/timing artifacts, and provenance_graph.json, and links the six rendered sibling views.

proposed_harness.name: tests/report/test_loop_provenance_links.py::test_provenance_graph_tracks_l05_views_as_non_source_outputs
proposed_harness.acceptance: provenance_graph.json contains nodes for L05 HTML/CSV/SVG views with source_of_truth=false and edges from JSON source artifacts to rendered views; no rendered view has outgoing source edges.

proposed_harness.name: tests/ci/test_loop_report_gate.py::test_loop_report_cli_generates_schema_and_golden_valid_bundle
proposed_harness.acceptance: The CI/static gate runs the L05 renderer, validates relevant JSON schemas, runs tests/report L05 tests, and explicitly forbids VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN plus scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, and scripts/fault_failover_gate.py.

proposed_harness.name: schemas/artifact/loop_report_manifest.schema.json
proposed_harness.acceptance: If a manifest JSON is added to prove rendered-view lineage, it records generated files, source artifact paths, source sha256 values, and non-source-of-truth status for HTML/CSV/SVG outputs, and is validated by tests and CI.

implementation_plan.step: Add an L05 loop-report renderer entrypoint that consumes only committed JSON/JSONL/CSV artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: Keep the P09 renderer stable while adding a dedicated artifact-first L05 renderer that reads audit_report.json, metric_catalog.json, coverage_matrix.json, p13_p14_scale_audit.json, P13 scale ladder/timing JSON, and provenance_graph.json.

implementation_plan.step: Generate deterministic required views under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.
implementation_plan.rationale: Satisfy L05 acceptance outputs while ensuring each view is derived from machine-readable source artifacts and carries source paths/hashes where practical.

implementation_plan.step: Add focused renderer tests before or alongside implementation.
implementation_plan.rationale: Cover the new rendering surface: output existence, golden CSV/SVG/HTML structure, missing metric visualization, and provenance links.

implementation_plan.step: Extend provenance coverage for L05 report views without weakening existing P09/P11/P12/P13 graph checks.
implementation_plan.rationale: L05 views must be traceable to JSON sources while preserving the rule that rendered views are not source-of-truth.

implementation_plan.step: Optionally add a schema-valid loop report manifest if provenance graph alone cannot express all generated-view lineage.
implementation_plan.rationale: A small manifest can make source paths and output hashes explicit for regression tests, but it must not replace the required L05 outputs or become a source for metric values.

implementation_plan.step: Wire the static L05 report gate into CI without real Valkey or fault wrappers.
implementation_plan.rationale: Make the report-rendering harness continuously enforced while respecting L05's no-P14 and no-wrapper constraints.

acceptance_criteria: The L05 renderer writes all seven required outputs exactly under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.
coverage_matrix.csv is a deterministic view of coverage_matrix.json with no missing rows and no synthetic statuses.
coverage_heatmap.svg is a deterministic view of coverage_matrix.json and visually distinguishes COVERED, MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and 1000-dry-run cells.
scale_ladder.svg derives node counts, real evidence status, and P14 dry-run boundary only from scale_ladder_report.json and p13_p14_scale_audit.json.
p13_timing_waterfall.svg derives all timing bars from p13_timing_breakdown_scale_50.json and p13_timing_breakdown_scale_100.json; missing optional timing data is labeled with explicit reason.
missing_metrics.csv contains every MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE_YET metric from metric_catalog.json with non-empty reasons and blank/null value fields.
index.html links to every required rendered view and to the JSON sources used to produce the view.
provenance_graph.json validates against schemas/artifact/provenance_graph.schema.json and records L05 report views as source_of_truth=false if they are represented as nodes.
Tests fail if a rendered SVG/CSV/HTML output hardcodes a value that diverges from its JSON input fixture.
No L05 command runs P14, sets VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, or invokes scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py.
risks: Golden tests can become brittle if they assert whole-file SVG layout; prefer stable semantic substrings, data attributes, headers, row order, counts, and hashes of canonicalized content.
Extending build_provenance_graph.py to include L05 views could accidentally classify report views as source artifacts; tests must assert source_of_truth=false and no outgoing source edges from views.

Existing provenance_graph.json was generated before L05 view outputs exist; the implementation must regenerate it after rendering or define a deterministic two-step render/provenance/render-index sequence.
If source artifacts are absent in a developer checkout, renderer behavior must encode MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON sections rather than fabricate values or silently pass.
Adding a new manifest schema is useful for lineage, but it must not distract from the explicitly required L05 output files.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not hardcode numeric coverage counts, timing durations, node counts, or metric values in HTML/SVG/CSV generation.
Do not parse Markdown reports to obtain source data.
Do not treat .html, .svg, .csv, or .md report views as metric source artifacts.
Do not convert MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET into zero, PASS, or empty success rows.
Do not run P14, set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, or invoke real/fault wrapper scripts for L05.
Do not modify historical phase or gate artifacts to make rendering easier.
Do not weaken schemas, required fields, enum values, real_valkey_required flags, or min-node expectations.
Do not handwrite PASS into gate results or historical audit artifacts.
commands_to_run: python3 -m pytest -q tests/report tests/provenance tests/metrics tests/coverage tests/ci/test_loop_report_gate.py
notes: Approved for implementation with a harness-first approach. The main gap is not source-artifact validation, which already exists, but deterministic L05 view generation and regression tests proving those views remain artifact-derived, preserve missing semantics, link provenance, and keep P14 as dry-run-only.
